GenAiFunction.description: Returns an Asset detail view (product, serial number, status, price, quantity, install/purchase/usage dates, lifecycle timer, owning account and contact) rendered as the Asset Detail HXL widget. Accepts an Asset name, a serial number, OR a 15/18-char Asset Id in assetRef; it resolves names and serial numbers on its own, so pass whatever the user said and do not ask the user for an Id first.
